verdict.reasons: Core defect: technical evidence mismatch and misrepresentation of hardware. The scene depicts a large commercial product carton/roll placed directly on the soil alongside the crop, rather than showing the thin, flattened installed drip tape integrated into the field as requested. The article and intended evidence focus on monitoring installed drip tape (نوار تیپ) and visualizing the resulting wet-soil strip (نشتی); however, the installed infrastructure here appears as a thick, rigid black supply line or hose, which is an unrelated plumbing component. The white tape exiting the carton does not properly connect to this line to form a plausible, continuous drip-tape network, and the distinct dark wet-soil strip explicitly required to illustrate root-zone watering is not clearly present in the scene. The uninstalled, oversized carton roll acts as an unsubstituted commercial placeholder, undermining the article's practical narrative and violating the requirement for a coherent, realistic field integration.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
